sourceSemantics.title: Foreign Exchange Rates
sourceSemantics.unit: U.S. cents per unit of foreign currency
sourceSemantics.method1: Monthly average of daily noon buying quotations for cable transfers in NewYork.
sourceSemantics.method2: Monthly average of daily closing quotations published by NewYork Journal of Commerce; preserve the selected-country footnote2 binding.
sourceSemantics.currency: Named quoted instrument observed at the actual final quoted month, not a validity interval or sole legal tender declaration.
sourceSemantics.parExchange: Par exchange column is not a monthly market quotation and is not approved as an additional claim.
sourceSemantics.observationDates: 1930-04/05/06 generally; Turkey footnotes7/8/9 imply1930-02/03/04. Egypt literal6/7/9: first ambiguous, secondFebruary, thirdApril. Never retime to July.
